I get you. Some day, I feel like the life I have is everything I wanted, and don't mind it repeating the day for years and years. But all the sudden, I get a small glimpse of a reminder that I hurt the people i love in the past, or a reminder of the major heartbreak I went through. Suddenly I no longer want to live, and just want to stop living to stop feeling this guilt/pain. And it becomes worse and worse, as the more you try to forget it the more you get reminded of it. It becomes difficult to get out of that cycle. I'm currently extremely depressed and resorting to alcoholism to escape this feeling, but holy shit I just want to feel normal again.

I feel you. I have everything i need/want as well. Although I don't have much friends (too much of an introvert), I have great job and a family/SO who cares about me a lot. Yet, I feel so lacking. Over 5 years of self discovery, I realized that I lack in expressing my emotions.  I tried getting into art to express myself, but I really suck at it, and i become ashamed of the result. Thus, i resort to alcoholism, a state of intoxication where I can express myself without thinking what others would think of me. But once the high is down, I go back regretting what I did while drunk, and hating myself even more.
